name: Bahar Pars
bio: Bahar Pars is an Iranian-Swedish actress and director, known for A Man Called Ove (2015), Turkkiosken (2017) and Operation Ragnarok (2018). She is married to Linus Tunström. They have one child.

credits.title: The Christmas Switch
credits.overview: Craving a change of pace, work-hard-play-hard city girl Freddie swaps lives with her homebody sister Mattie at Christmas time, only to unwrap a whole new kind of mess.

credits.title: Just Like a Boy
credits.overview: In a land where sexuality can mean life or death, a refugee girl must become someone else to survive.

credits.title: A Copenhagen Love Story
credits.overview: After author Mia finds love with single father Emil, their happiness is put to the test as they undergo fertility treatments to have kids of their own.

credits.title: Handling the Undead
credits.overview: On a hot summer day in Oslo, the dead mysteriously awaken, and three families are thrown into chaos when their deceased loved ones come back to them. Who are they, and what do they want?

credits.title: Högläsning av Röde Orm
credits.overview: Directly from Borgeby Castle in Skåne, the fast-paced story Röde Orm is told by Frans G. Bengtsson. Among others, Sten Ljunggren, Angela Kovacs and Martin E-type Eriksson read the humorous story about the young Viking's travels out into the world.

credits.title: The Conference
credits.overview: A ragtag group of public sector employees battle not only their own discord but also a bloodthirsty killer during a seemingly innocuous retreat.

credits.title: Donkeyland
credits.overview: Indra finds that people constantly discriminate against her and judge her due to her skin color. With a humorous and critical perspective, Donkeyland puts into words structural racism through a contested narrative.

credits.title: The Cake Dynasty
credits.overview: Middle-aged cake manufacturer Niels is on the verge of a breakdown as his factory is on the brink of bankruptcy. His wife Else tries to save the factory by calling home their daughter June and her husband Jonny, who propose a comprehensive modernization focused on the production of healthy cakes. credits.title: Maya Nilo (Laura)
credits.overview: Nilo is a feminist writer, living an orderly life with her husband and 13-year-old daughter Laura. When her irresponsible sister Maya, whose projects constantly tend to bomb, both "kidnaps" Nilo's Volvo and daughter and heads south, Nilo tags along. credits.title: The Year I Started Masturbating
credits.overview: Ambitious overachiever Hanna just needs one more kid before her life is perfect. Instead, her baby daddy unexpectedly dumps her. Suddenly, she finds herself without a place to live, job or family. With every fiber of her being set for victory, Hanna refuses to give up and decides to win him back. But to get there means

credits.title: Spit
credits.overview: Nellie and Jasse are 13 years old and best friends. Together they explore the world through physical challenges. But once Jasse starts hanging out with the cool girls at the skate ramp, the intimate world of girlhood friendship crumbles.

credits.title: Bergman Revisited
credits.overview: As we celebrate Ingmar Bergman, one of the greatest directors of all time, we asked how his legacy has affected Swedish filmmakers of today. Bergman Revisited is a compilation of six very different films, spanning from Bergmanesque drama to animated critical satire.

credits.title: Operation Ragnarok
credits.overview: A town in south of Sweden is isolated after a viral outbreak. The Swedes and immigrants still inside must band together to survive the onslaught.

credits.title: Ariel
credits.overview: A girl is born with wings. When Filip and Anna first realize that their newborn daughter is not like other children, they react in wildly opposing manners. Anna considers it a miracle, while Filip sees it as a stigma. In order to survive as an adult, are we required to sever our connection to the magical?

credits.title: The Turk Shop
credits.overview: At a creative firm somewhere in Stockholm, there's a short break in a meeting. Cecilia relates an anecdote from a hen party, about a 'Turk kiosk' that turned out to be closed. credits.title: Baby
credits.overview: Where the summer night slowly pivots to morning there are meetings of unexpected magic. Baby takes us on a captivating and fast-paced journey through the streets of Stockholm where tomorrow will not be as expected for new acquaintances made at night.

credits.title: A Man Called Ove
credits.overview: Despite being deposed as president of his condominium association, grumpy 59-year-old Ove continues to watch over his neighbourhood with an iron fist. credits.title: Ghetto Swedish
credits.overview: Aisatou is a racialised actress who has been employed for a voice job at advertising agency Måns & Petter. Everything seems fine to begin with, but Aisatou soon has to choose whether to follow the stereotype or refuse.

credits.title: Incident by a Bank
credits.overview: Incident by a bank is a detailed account of a failed bank robbery: A single take where over 90 people perform a meticulous choreography for the camera. The film recreates an actual event that took place in Stockholm in June 2006.

credits.title: Dreams
credits.overview: Goran just got out of high school and doesn't know what he wants to do with his life. credits.title: When Darkness Falls
credits.overview: A gripping and intense thriller about honour, loyalty, and the courage to fight for what you believe.

credits.title: Flickpingis
credits.overview: When Johan is dumped by his girlfriend, he does not know what to feel. He takes help from his loved ones, which may not always be the smartest thing to do.
